summary: 1st Franklin Financial Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amendment to its Loan and Security Agreement dated August 26, 2026. The amendment increases revolving credit borrowings to $430 million, extends maturity to August 2029 (subject to reinsurance facility), allows accordion increases up to $270 million, amends financial covenants (debt-to-tangible net worth max 5.00:1; collateral indicator below 25%), expands restricted payment baskets to 25% of prior-year net income, and raises bulk purchase limit to $50 million. No acquisition or strategic event is involved; this is a routine credit facility amendment. No deal terms apply.
